objective: Resolve one canonical CRM created-at relationship cohort and delegate that exact cohort once to the multi-dimension durable outcome snapshot application.

readPlan.outcomeSnapshot: one getSnapshot call over the exact resolved cohort

rules: CRM remains sole owner of created-at timestamp validation, lower-inclusive upper-exclusive boundaries, ordering, default limit, and limit validation.
The created-at relationship cohort is read exactly once.
Returned CRM relationship IDs are canonically validated before snapshot delegation.
The exact resolved relationship ID array is supplied to INS-004D once.
Requested dimensions are passed through unchanged; INS-004D owns dimension validation and deduplication.
Omitted limit remains omitted when constructing the CRM cohort query.
This represents lifetime-to-date durable outcome attainment for relationships created inside the requested date window.
Outcome occurredAt is not filtered by the created-at window.
No new SQL, date parsing, date rewriting, persistence mutation, percentage formatting, floating-point division, or status inference is introduced.
explicitlyDeferred: combined economics and outcome reporting DTO
